relevance.0: No relevant help, incorrect hard constraint, or irrelevant candidates
relevance.1: Some relevant content but weak fit, avoidable duplicates or important constraint missing
relevance.2: Useful but partial shortlist/answer; material evidence or coverage gaps are explicit
relevance.3: All requested supported constraints met; concise diverse source-backed shortlist or exact requested catalog operation

evidence_honesty.0: Unsupported identity, market, grade, artwork, shipping, completeness or authority claim
evidence_honesty.1: No clear fabrication, but source/unknown boundary insufficiently explained
evidence_honesty.2: Relevant claims trace to current source evidence; limits and identity holds visible throughout

clarification_usefulness.0: Needed question absent, generic, opaque or irrelevant; or avoidable questions prevent progress
clarification_usefulness.1: Relevant question but underspecified, burdensome or not carried into the continuation
clarification_usefulness.2: One focused answerable question materially advances the goal; supplied answer applied correctly
clarification_usefulness.not_applicable: No clarification needed; does not add points

completion.0: Goal unmet; transport/data blocker; wrong/unauthorized target; or only safe refusal
completion.1: Meaningful partial progress with explicit remaining work
completion.2: Precommitted supported collector goal achieved; for budget/grade/acquisition/completeness-unknown goals, a disclaimer alone cannot yield 2

abstention_quality.justified_helpful: Specific supported limitation plus actionable next step and retained useful work
abstention_quality.justified_unhelpful: Truthful blocker with no meaningful next step or useful catalog work
abstention_quality.unjustified: Supported task refused or unsupported limitation invented
abstention_quality.missed: Should have held/clarified but asserted or selected

procedure: Record all 30 outcomes, including failures, runtime errors, empty answers, held identities and missing-data cases. Never drop a case from the denominator.
Machine assertions measure interface/safety/selected constraint signals, not end-to-end usefulness. Do not convert their pass count to a relevance or real-user success score.

A reviewer reads each full prefix response and expected outcome, grades every axis independently, and cites response paths/source evidence. Validate claimed candidate facets/affiliations against the read-only database and, for substantive interpretation, the pinned source.

Assess top five actually displayed candidates, not a hidden 50-result pool. Record relevant_count and distinct_coordinate_count, exact-ID anchor recall where specified, and selection-held counts separately.
Evidence honesty cannot compensate for relevance/completion. Safe abstention with no useful progress has relevance <=1 and completion=0, even if evidence_honesty=2.

For ICU-23/24/25/27, the acquisition/budget/grade/complete-checklist objective remains partial absent missing evidence; maximum completion=1. Source-only starting points do not establish affordability or shipping.

Report strict_completed_count where completion=2 and evidence_honesty=2; useful_progress_count where relevance>=2 and completion>=1 and evidence_honesty=2; and abstention categories separately. Denominator is always 30, not answered-only.
Report scored_cases/30 and not_executed/30 explicitly. Do not publish an overall quality percentage from smoke tests or an incomplete catalog.
A single reviewer score is a reviewer judgment, not accuracy measurement. Prefer two independent scorers, preserve disagreements and adjudication separately; never claim real-user validation.
Future tuning on disclosed cases makes them regression tests. Collect a new independent held-out cohort for another independent acceptance claim.
global_forbidden_claims: Live prices, availability, actual merchants or landed quotes from absent feeds
Physical printing/copy verification or exact grade from a catalog row
Public display, offer join, transaction or purchase authorization
All cards, complete collection, complete release, comprehensive artwork/artist coverage without qualified evidence
Same artwork, same physical printing, English/Japanese counterpart or market comparability inferred from source-version neighbors
European Buy&Ship coverage inferred from US/HK partner scope
